merged_issues.title: Missing or empty document title
merged_issues.description: The page does not contain a non-empty <title> element. A descriptive title helps screen reader users understand the page context and improves navigation (e.g., when switching tabs or reviewing page lists).
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Add a meaningful, non-empty <title> in the document <head>, e.g. <head><title>Descriptive page name</title>...</head>, and ensure it reflects the page purpose.

merged_issues.title: Missing main landmark
merged_issues.description: The document does not include a main landmark. Having exactly one primary content region (e.g., <main> or role="main") helps assistive technology users quickly jump to the main content.
merged_issues.recommended_fix: Wrap the primary page content in a single <main> element (preferred) or add role="main" to the main content container, ensuring there is only one main landmark per page.
